text: My education and qualifications are: I am proud to be a candidate for Dublin City Council, District 4. Dublin has become one of California’s most vibrant communities because of the dedication of its residents and civic leaders. I want to contribute by serving our community with honesty, accountability, and hard work. My priorities include enhancing public safety, supporting excellent schools, helping local businesses succeed, maintaining beautiful parks and neighborhoods, and planning responsibly for the future. I believe effective leadership begins with listening, respecting different viewpoints, and working together to find practical solutions. As a business executive, I understand the importance of responsibility, collaboration, and long-term planning. If elected, I will work every day to represent every resident with fairness and transparency. I respectfully ask for your support and your vote so we can continue building a community that is safe, welcoming, and prosperous for generations to come. Together, let’s build a Safer, Stronger Dublin. Shivraj Singh

text: My education and qualifications are: For the past four years, I’ve had the honor of serving as your councilmember and, last year, as your Vice Mayor. I’ve worked to make Dublin safer, more transparent, and more welcoming for everyone by championing Dublin’s diversity, expanding support for our youth, and strengthening our community’s regional impact. My priorities are: 1. Thoughtful Growth & Development - Dublin can grow without losing the character residents love through new housing and business opportunities. 2. Traffic & Infrastructure - As Dublin grows, so does the traffic on our roads. I’m focused on smart infrastructure that eases daily congestion. 3. Public Safety & Community Well-Being - A safe Dublin is a strong Dublin. I support our public safety partners while expanding parks, programs, and services that support families, seniors, and youth. Serving on regional and county committees, including the Finance and Investment Committee, Federal and Military Communities and affordable housing, played a major role in sharpening my leadership approach. This approach is rooted in fiscal responsibility, data-driven decisions, and a commitment to hearing every voice. I promise to continue working with you. Let’s go further, together. I’d be honored to have your support. I’m always available at (925) 587-8299, hello@kashef4dublin.com, or on Instagram @kashef4dublin Learn more at kashef4dublin.com.
